audit.entries: 30 (10 per fold, seed 20261001), plain loops, tolerance 1e-9

decision_rule_verbatim.GENERIC ACCESSIBILITY: generality controls remove > 50% of the log-IRR (ret < 0.5)
decision_rule_verbatim.HOST-SPECIFIC: A_lift CI excludes 1 (M3; CRV1 t(G-1) CI per fold, IVW CI pooled) AND retention >= 0.5
decision_rule_verbatim.implementation: 'excludes 1' is read as CI entirely above 1 (a CI entirely below 1 is reported as a negative lift and labelled MIXED unless ret < 0.5)
qualifiers: fragile: randomisation p of the focal term (M1 A_cont or M3 A_lift) > 0.05 while CRV1 p < 0.05
decision_rule_verbatim.reading: the POOLED verdict is the paper's reading; fold verdicts are descriptive

definitions.A_lift: ln((A_cont + c0) / s_dB); c0 = 0.5 x smallest positive A_cont in the fold if any A_cont == 0 (else 0)
definitions.A_spec: entry mean of residuals of tag-level OLS s_pd = a_B + b1 H_p + b2 F_p + b3 ln s_dB (per fold)
definitions.G_H, G_F: tag-count-weighted entry means of H_p, F_p; MeSH: EXACT-profiled tags only (primary)
definitions.G_H_bg: MeSH sensitivity (S8): exact + bg tags, bg entropy from design-weighted shares
definitions.H_p: -sum_d P_pd ln P_pd / ln K_B, P over OBSERVED subfield counts excluding 'unknown'; K_B = #subfields with > 0 works in subfield_year_totals 'all_types' summed over B's five years
definitions.H_p_ub: missing tail (total_known - observed) spread evenly over the K_B - n_observed unobserved subfields
definitions.retention: ret = b_A(M1)/b_A(M0) (= ratio of log-IRR/SD: identical sample and SD); ret_lift = b(M3)/b(M2); pct_removed = 100 (1 - ret)
definitions.s_dB: sum_{y in B} totals(d,y) / sum_{y in B} sum_sf totals(sf,y), 'all_types'
definitions.split_generality: GH_k = sum_{class-k tags} H_p / n_gen_tags (k: NATIVE s>=0.30, ADJACENT 0.05<=s<0.30, FOREIGN s<0.05); same for F
definitions.tag_multiset: entry-year d-paper partner tags (own node dropped), PROFILED tags only (as A_cont)

deviations_declared_before_coefficients: git commit of the spec replaced by sha256 + UTC timestamp (workspace is published as a folder of the run repository; a nested .git would break the publish)
power simulation uses the fixed observed design instead of concept resampling (retention is a within-sample ratio)
IVW pools log-IRR/SD rather than raw b (fold SDs differ: MeSH vs main)
estimator: vendored exp_7 ppml.fit via models.fit_one (iterated singleton/separation pruning), CRV1 by concept with t(G-1)

folds.heldout: main OpenAlex held-out fold (opened once in iteration 4; lock sha256 recorded in gates.json)
folds.mesh: exp_9 MeSH replication: outcomes_mesh.parquet, dropna(A_cont, CT, secondary_controls)
folds.screen: main OpenAlex, co-primary sample (eval_2 g_samples.coprimary_sample, fold='screen')

inference.bootstrap: 1000 concept-cluster draws (g_lib.resample_concepts), all models refit per draw; percentile CI
inference.holm_use: reported, not used in the rule
inference.placebo_calibrated: 2 * Phi(-|z| / SD_z) with SD_z of the recorded nativeness-permutation placebo z (main: d2 placebo_draws.csv z_A_secondary; MeSH: placebo_draws_mesh.csv z_A_R2)
inference.randomisation: within-concept Freedman-Lane: residualise focal regressor on the other regressors + concept/e/d FE (linear), permute residuals within concept, add back fitted part, refit PPML; p = (1 + #{|z_perm| >= |z_obs|}) / (1 + R)

ivw.pooled_ci_for_rule: IVW normal 95% CI of the pooled A_lift log-IRR/SD in M3
ivw.pooled_retention: ret_pool = lnIRR1_pool / lnIRR0_pool; CI from 1000 combined draws: draw k of each fold (b_k x SD_fold) pooled with the SAME fixed IVW weights, ratio, percentiles
ivw.quantity: log-IRR/SD (b x SD_fold, SE x SD_fold) from CRV1; fixed-effect IVW; Cochran Q, I^2

k2_sample_rule: co-primary input sample minus rows with missing G_H, G_F or A_lift; M0..M3 all fitted on this IDENTICAL input sample (PPML pruning depends only on y and FE); M0 on the full co-primary sample is the GATE-B row
label: POST-CONFIRMATION EXPLORATORY
name: K2: host-specific vs generic accessibility of the confirmed A_cont host-entry effect
outcome: Y_strict (W2 host papers by author-disjoint newcomers)

power_step3.DGP_G: ln mu = ln mu0 + gamma (Ahat - mean), Ahat = linear within-FE projection of A_cont on G_H, G_F; gamma = beta_rec / R2_within so the implied M0 b_A = beta_rec; not constructible if R2_within < 0.02
power_step3.DGP_S: ln mu = ln mu0 + beta_rec (A_cont - mean); beta_rec = recorded co-primary b_A
power_step3.design: fixed observed design (no concept resampling), y ~ Poisson(Gamma(theta, mu/theta))
power_step3.mu0: PPML fit of Y on CT + controls + G_H + G_F (no A term)
power_step3.report: P(ret >= 0.5 | S), P(ret < 0.5 | G), 2.5-97.5% of ret_hat per fold and IVW pool

supplementary.S1: primary FE (concept x e + d x e) M0/M1 + retention; thin-cell flag G < 50 or retained < 0.30
supplementary.S10: placebo host under M1: 100 size-decile draws (g_lib.placebo_candidates; MeSH also coverage rule 0.30), A_plac + CT + G_H + G_F + controls and joint; PASS if share_pos_sig <= 0.10 AND median placebo IRR/SD < 1.10
supplementary.S11: EST_bin LPM (secondary FE) with M0/M1 regressors: direction only
supplementary.S2: A_cont + GH_nat + GH_adj + GH_for + GF_nat + GF_adj + GF_for; retention of A_cont vs M0
supplementary.S3: NAT + ADJ (FOREIGN reference) with and without G_H + G_F; retention of NAT and ADJ
supplementary.S5: A_cont residualised on G_H, G_F + FE, entered alone (interpreted only if |within-FE r| > 0.8)
supplementary.S8: MeSH only: G_H_bg in place of G_H (M1)
supplementary.bootstrap_S_rows: S1, S2, S3, S6 retention CIs from the same 1000 bootstrap draws
